evidence_quotes.O: I disassembled the cable to see what it was, and it is merely 3 RCA connectors going to the USB port.

evidence_quotes.A: Purchased this as a gift for someone who has constant navigational issues anywhere they go.
evidence_quotes.N: Rather than bend the cable too much (which has proven disastrous to me in the past), I went looking for a good right angle adapter.
